content:
BUT WHAT ABOUT THE NATURAL SCIENCES, I would ask. Six weeks later, WE HAVE 4.530 ENTRIES ON THIS IN 190 SUBDIVISIONS, came the reply. I would think about you and the natural sciences. Your response—a mute bond—would be already out-of-date, new entries inhaled through the breath of the telegraph. I would sit on top of my card cabinet fluttering the to date seventeen responses I had received, and kicking my legs.
—I WANT TO KNOCK THE CEILING WITH THE TOP OF MY HEAD, I then sent.
—THAT IS NOT HOW HEADS WORK. THEY ARE TOO COMPACT, in response.

The operator on this end had drawn three question marks, under the message, on the card, in disbelief. The operator on this end had black hair and green eyes. With all who had taken part, I would not know where to focus my attention within the relay or as we may think. ∎

parent.content:
Thanks for coming and
you made it
You made to the Volvelle Social Club
It’s our annual meeting
and thanks for coming

We are moving devices yet
clubs of five are outlawed.
Everyone signs up in a round-robin
and we can’t have a pentagram
So no clubs of five

It’s hot today
Really hot inside
It feels about 72 degrees
Not very good weather
for an annual meeting.

But let’s press on
The heat of our bodies
has made things worse
(The heat) Let’s start.
Add a disc to the Volvelle.

An ionic column and
our volunteers and
partners are energetic. You
look so well I hardly believe it
Like an ionic column

Dearest members note
we begin the program
very energetically.
You can change your mind
If you want you can

When the fifth person joins
You go into hibernation.
It’s imperative that
you sleep until the next
Interested person is found.

At first this was painful
But it’s adventure really
All five of you there and
a sleeping adventure
and not Convening

You will be fine but
things don’t look good though.
It’s sort-of stuck between two.
Just rattle the pin and
Add a disc to the Volvelle please
